remarks: Calling Stamford Investors! This 2 family in the Glenbrook neighborhood of Stamford is waiting to be updated. The first floor has 3 bedrooms, with a room in the back that was previously used as a 4th bedroom. The second floor has 2 bedrooms, with a walk up attic that can be finished for additional living space. The backyard is large and private, and fully fenced in for privacy. Roof is less than 10 years old and there is gas connected to the house for an easy conversion to gas mechanicals. Property to be sold AS IS/WHERE IS. Please note, the property needs a good amount of work. *Multiple offers received, Highest and Best offers due by 5:00 pm Wednesday 12/11.*
